title.zh: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash发布：以缓存效率降成本

excerpt.zh: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash采用原生视觉理解和非对称架构，重点降低缓存与推理成本，但关键性能数据仍待独立验证。
excerpt.en: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash adds native vision and an asymmetric architecture aimed at lower cache and inference costs, though independent validation is still needed.

text.zh: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的发布重点
text.en: What DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Introduces

text.zh: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash是DeepSeek宣布的新一代架构家族成员，也是其中规模最小的模型。官方将它定位为更聪明、更快且更高效，并强调原生视觉理解能力。对开发者而言，这次发布的核心不只是模型名称变化，而是把吞吐、缓存占用和大规模服务成本放在了同一设计目标中。
text.en: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is the smallest announced member of DeepSeek’s new architecture family. The company presents it as smarter, faster, and more efficient, with native visual understanding. For developers, the release is notable not merely as a new model name, but as an effort to address throughput, cache usage, and the cost of serving large workloads together.

text.zh: 架构与缓存效率
text.en: Architecture and Cache Efficiency

text.zh: DeepSeek称，该模型采用5520亿参数的混合专家架构，并使用新的因果编码器—解码器设计。官方给出的工作量描述是：输入阶段激活约80亿参数，输出阶段激活约160亿参数。也就是说，模型总参数量与每次处理实际参与计算的参数量并不相同，这种非对称安排可能有助于平衡能力与推理资源。
text.en: DeepSeek says the model uses a 552-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts design and a new causal encoder-decoder architecture. Its stated execution profile activates about 8 billion parameters for input and 16 billion for output. The distinction matters: total parameters are not the same as parameters used for each computation. This asymmetric arrangement may help balance model capacity against inference resources, although the practical effect depends on implementation and workload.

text.zh: 官方还表示，与上一代相比，V4.1-Flash的KV缓存只需四分之一的高带宽内存，以及八分之一的固态硬盘存储。KV缓存会保存上下文中的中间信息，代理系统在多轮调用时尤其依赖它。若这些比例能在真实部署中复现，长上下文或高并发应用就可能减少内存压力与缓存相关支出。
text.en: The company also claims that V4.1-Flash requires one-quarter as much HBM and one-eighth as much SSD storage for its KV cache compared with the previous generation. KV caches retain intermediate context information and are particularly important in multi-step agent systems. If those ratios hold in production, applications with long contexts or high concurrency could reduce memory pressure and cache-related spending.

text.zh: API使用与实际影响
text.en: API Availability and Practical Impact

text.zh: V4.1-Flash已经通过DeepSeek API提供原生多模态支持，调用模型名为deepseek-flash。旧的V4-Flash与V4-Flash-Vision-Exp已退役，兼容名称暂时会路由到新模型。DeepSeek表示将降低API价格，并继续实行峰谷定价，非高峰费率为高峰费率的一半。这为可延迟任务提供了调度空间，但实际账单仍取决于调用量、上下文长度和缓存命中情况。
text.en: V4.1-Flash is available through the DeepSeek API with native multimodal support under the model name deepseek-flash. The earlier V4-Flash and V4-Flash-Vision-Exp models have been retired, while compatibility names temporarily route to the new model. DeepSeek says API prices will be lower and that peak and off-peak pricing will continue, with off-peak rates set at half of peak rates. This creates scheduling opportunities for delay-tolerant jobs, but real bills will still depend on request volume, context length, and cache-hit behavior.

text.zh: 对产品团队来说，较低缓存成本可能比单次响应速度更重要，因为代理工作流常常重复携带工具结果、历史对话和任务状态。多模态输入也让图像相关任务可以直接纳入同一接口。不过，是否适合替换现有模型，应结合延迟、视觉准确率、长上下文稳定性和错误恢复表现进行小规模测试，而不能只依据发布口号。
text.en: For product teams, lower cache costs may matter more than raw single-request speed because agent workflows repeatedly carry tool results, conversation history, and task state. Native multimodal input could also bring image-related tasks into the same interface. Still, replacement decisions should be based on small-scale tests covering latency, visual accuracy, long-context stability, and error recovery rather than on launch messaging alone.

text.zh: 限制、开放问题与结论
text.en: Limits, Open Questions, and Takeaway

text.zh: 目前源信息没有提供完整基准、价格表、上下文上限、硬件要求或独立评测，也没有说明“领先”结论对应哪些测试。因此，5520亿参数、激活参数和缓存比例应视为厂商披露，而非已经普遍证实的行业结论。部署方还需要确认模型路由、兼容别名的有效期限，以及开源推理支持和更多部署选项何时落地。
text.en: The supplied information does not include complete benchmarks, a price table, context limits, hardware requirements, or independent evaluations. It also does not specify which tests support the claim of leading results. The parameter counts, activation figures, and cache ratios should therefore be treated as vendor disclosures rather than broadly established industry findings. Deployment teams should also verify the lifetime of compatibility routes and the timing of planned open-source inference support and additional deployment options.

text.zh: 总体看，DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的卖点是以非对称计算和更小KV缓存服务高吞吐、多模态应用。它可能特别适合代理、批处理和对成本敏感的视觉任务，但优势必须在目标硬件与真实流量下衡量。当前最稳妥的判断是：这是一次面向效率的架构与定价更新，值得测试，却还不足以仅凭官方摘要证明全面超越上一代或竞争模型。
text.en: Overall, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is positioned around asymmetric computation and a smaller KV cache for high-throughput, multimodal applications. It may be especially relevant to agents, batch processing, and cost-sensitive vision workloads, but its advantages need to be measured on target hardware and real traffic. The most defensible conclusion is that this is an efficiency-focused architecture and pricing update worth testing, not yet evidence from the supplied summary alone that it universally outperforms its predecessor or competing models.
